entities.name: Yahya ibn Sarafyun
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Yahya ibn Sarafyun a Syriac physician from Damascus, known in Europe as Johannes Serapion, and commonly called Serapion the Elder to distinguish him from Serapion the Younger, with whom he was often confused.
